_comment: OPTIONAL. Copy to config.json (gitignored) only to override defaults. The Window Switcher's settings panel edits the same values in the GUI, so most people need no config file.
_filter_comment: terminals | all — which windows the dial scrolls by default (toggle live with a Window Filter key).
_terminalRegex_comment: process names (regex) that count as a terminal for the 'terminals' filter.
_komorebicPath_comment: command/path for komorebic; defaults to 'komorebic' on PATH.
